buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name South Coast Railway-IREPS Receipts Account No. 45206745356 IFSC Code SBIN0004266 Bank Name STATE BANK OF INDIA Branch address SBI CMPOC HYDERABAD BRANCH (004266) . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Sr.DFM / BZA South Coast Railway Vijayawada, Ministry of Railways A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of

contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The following conditions are also to be ensured. 1 Mandatory documents are provided in the scope of work document. Ensure to submit all mandatory do cuments. All documents / certificates submitted shall be self-attested. 2. In case of any discrepancy additional terms and conditions of the BID will prevail. 3. Penalties will be as per the Scope of work of the bid / Special conditions of contract. 4 The bid will be evaluated as per tender document uploaded at Introduction about the project / services being proposed for procurement using custom bid functionality. 5. Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. Rupees Seventy Seven Lakhs Eleven Thousand Forty Eight and Paise Eighty only SCOPE OF WORK Name of the Work: Hiring of one no. Non-AC 32+1 seater mini bus for Trainees manag ement at ETTC/BZA for a period of three years. 1. One No. of 32+1 seater bus in a good working condition with driver is to be provided at ETT C/BZA and the utilization of bus must cover the following activities during the contract period: a) For the official movement of trainees & faculty to visitfield training locations as specified b y Principal/ETTC/BZA. Some of the locations are mentioned below: i. Freight Trip Shed/BZA for Locomotives ii. Passenger Trip Shed/BZA for Locomotives iii. Electric Loco Shed/BZA for Locomotives and KAVACH training iv. Diesel Loco Shed/BZA for SPIC, SPART, SPMRV v. C&W Depot/BZA for WAGONS (Conventional & BMBS) vi. Coaching Depot/BZA for ICF and LHB Coaches vii. Combined Crew Lobby/BZA viii. Running Room/BZA ix. RRI Cabin/BZA for signaling system explanation x. Traffic Yards/BZA for yard movements explanation xi. Control Office in DRM Office/BZA xii. Traction Sub Station / KCC xiii. KI, RYP, RMV, NDM Railway stations for WAG-12B Locomotives, Push pull, WABTEC L ocomotives, 3-Phase MEMU rakes xiv. Any other movement specified or advised by Principal/ETTC/BZA. b) For the official departmental movements as and when required with the approval of Sr.D EE/TRSO/BZA. c) For official movements in the jurisdiction mentioned vide point 20 (r) of clause 7.0 - Other conditions under special conditions of contract). 2. The general timings for which the vehicle shall be made available for ETTC/BZA are from 07. 00 hrs. to 19.00 hrs.However, if any change in timings is required, the Supervisor In-charge shall intimate the same to the contractor, and the contractor shall ensure availability of the ve hicle as per the revised timings. a) The vehicle shall normally be required for 22 days in a month, as per the training progra mme and requirements of ETTC/BZA. Generally, the vehicle may not be required on Sundays and holidays declared by ETTC/BZA. The days on which the vehicle is not required(other t han Sundays and such holidays)in a month will be intimated to the contractor at least one da y in advance, and the contractor shall arrange the vehicle as directed by the Supervisor In-ch arge. b) However, if the vehicle is required on Sundays, holidays or any other day due to the tr aining programme or operational requirements of ETTC/BZA, the same will be intimated to the contractor at least one day in advance, and the contractor shall arrange the vehicle as direc ted by the Supervisor In-charge. 3. a) The vehicle shall be operated for a base 1000 KMs run per month with a cumulative run of 36000KMs for three period considering run for 12 hours/day for 22 days in a month. Paym ent will be made as per accepted rate per month for item (a) of Sch-A in price schedule irres

pective of KMs runin the month (month as described in this point). b) Extra run days over 22 days in a month shall be operated as per requirement and paymen t will be made as per accepted rate per day for item (a) of Sch-B of price schedule. c) Extra hours over 12 hours in a day shall be operated as per requirement and payment will be made as per accepted rate per hour for item (b) of Sch-B of price schedule. 4. The work has to be carried out under the control of Supervisor in-charge. 5. A log book shall be maintained as decided by the supervisor in-charge which will be regular ly filled by the driver duly signed by the railway officials using the vehicles and verified regul arly with a counter-signature by the Supervisor In-charge daily. 6. The vehicle should be in good condition and must not be older than 3 years on th e date of opening of tender. Otherwise, the bid shall be summarily rejected. 7. The vehicle provided by the contractor shall be conform to the following minimu m technical specifications. S.No Parameter Tender Specification 1 Fuel Diesel or CNG 2 No. of seats &arrange Minimum 32 passenger seats + 1 driver, Seats arran ment gement- preferable 2×2 3 Diesel: minimum 100 Ltrs tank capacity; Fuel tank (diesel) / cyli nder capacity (CNG) CNG: minimum 400 Ltrs cylinder capacity 4 No. of wheels Front: 2; Rear: 4 5 Power Minimum 90 kW 6 Torque Minimum 450 Nm 7 Transmission type and Manual transmission with minimum 5 forward gears a gears nd 1 reverse gear 8 Gross vehicle weight Minimum 8.5 Tonnes 9 12 V or 24 V electrical system; battery capacity mini Battery mum 120 Ah 10 Brakes type Air brakes 11 Suspension Parabolic or Air suspension, front and rear 12 Steering Power steering 13 Emission norm BS-VI Stage II compliance Note: 1. Eicher/Tata/Ashok Leyland/Mahindra or similar meeting the above minimum technical specifications is acceptable.

2. The bidder needs submit the manufacturer's technical specification sheet and other documents related to the offered bus for verification of the bus details. 3.The bidder shall submit declaration regarding the correctness of minimum technical specifications submitted by him/her for the offered bus.Bids with out the submission of below declaration shall be summarily rejected. DECLARATION "I/We hereby declare that the vehicle offered by me/us (Make ______, Model ______, Regi stration No. ______, Date of initial registration ______) meets the minimum technical spe cifications as mentioned in point no.7 of scope of work, and that the details furnished h erein are true and correct. Further, If any detail(s) is/are found incorrect, my/our bid sh all be liable for rejection." Signature of the tenderer 8. The contractor shall provide the bus, and shall maintain it with all fitments and safety equip ment, in accordance with the Central Motor Vehicles Rulesand relevant standards, as amende d from time to time, at the contractor’s own cost throughout the contract period. 9. The vehicles provided should have driver with valid license, supplied with fuel, Consumables and arrangements for regular maintenance. All the taxes, Toll gate fee etc., are to be paid by t he contractor as per the requirement. Contractor shall submit copies of valid vehicle RC book, valid insurance, valid pollution certificate, valid permit, fitness certificate of the supplied vehic le, valid license of driver and any other statutory documents required to be carried for driving as per the provisions of the Motor Vehicles Act and rules, to the supervisor in-charge and to th e office of Sr.DEE/TRSO/BZA for commencement of the work. 10. The vehicle should comply with the pollution norms of the RTA and the pollution check shou ld be carried out periodically from an authorized agency and the valid certificate to that effe ct should be made available in the vehicle at all times. 11. The driver of the vehicle should possess a cell phone round the clock for receiving instructio ns from the Railways regarding the movement of the vehicle. The cell phone should not be k ept in switched off condition at any time. Driver shall always be cautious while driving and ov er speeding shall always be prevented. 12. Apart from this, in case the contractor wants to change the vehicle at any time during the c ontract period, he may do so by providing the new vehicle by satisfying the tender condition s. However, to change the vehicle, the contractor shall obtain the approval of Sr.DEE/TRSO/ BZA. 13. Disaster Management: The vehicles and equipment provided by the contractor can be draft ed by Railway administration in case of accidents/natural calamities involving human lives fo r this purpose, payment will be made duly operating the item as a non-schedule item as per the norms and powers delegated to the Railway. 14. Vehicle driver should wear proper neat and clean formal uniform with shoes.Identity card s hall be issued to the driver signed by the contractor with Contract No., Name of the person, P lace of work etc., and affixed at a conspicuous place on his/her dress while performing Railw ay duties. 15. The vehicles should be made available throughout the contract period for the use of the Ra ilways as per the directions of supervisor in-charge. 16. Railway shall not be responsible in case of any accident or mishap involving the road vehicl es and will not be liable to pay any damage/compensation due to the accident of road vehicl es to the contractor or any third party. 17. In case of any damage or loss caused to the Railway property due to the accident involving

the contractor's vehicle, the contractor shall be fully liable to pay the loss of damage sustain ed to Railways. 18. Any illegal article/material transported at any time in the vehicle will result in termination o f contract and the PG available will stand forfeited. No correspondence in this matter will be entertained. 19. Cost of parking of vehicles, if any, will have to be borne entirely by the contractor. 20. The contractor is solely responsible for the safety and security of his vehicles along with dri vers and the Railway will not have any liability in case of thefts/damages, legal disputes etc. 21. The contractor shall not have any claims for increase of rate or any hike in the price of fuel / taxes etc., during the period of currency and the same accepted rate will remain applicable across the entire period of the contract. 22. The driver should be provided with all essential tools, accessories and spares and be fully c apable to attend to minor repairs and breakdowns in case of emergency. 23. Suitable penalties will be levied in case of failure of contractor during the contract period a s mentioned in clause 4.8 of Special Conditions of Contract. .
